definition_en: The ability to communicate effectively in multiple languages, adapting content and tone for different linguistic and cultural contexts.
definition_ms: Keupayaan untuk berkomunikasi dengan berkesan dalam pelbagai bahasa, serta menyesuaikan kandungan dan nada mengikut konteks bahasa dan budaya.
typical_tasks_en:
• Translate the patient intake form into Mandarin and Malay for the local community.
• Interpret between the Korean supplier and the English-speaking procurement team.
• Adapt the marketing email tone for Malay-speaking audiences in East Malaysia.
typical_tasks_ms:
• Terjemahkan borang pengambilan pesakit ke bahasa Mandarin dan Melayu untuk komuniti setempat.
• Tafsir antara pembekal Korea dan pasukan perolehan yang berbahasa Inggeris.
• Sesuaikan nada e-mel pemasaran untuk audiens berbahasa Melayu di Malaysia Timur.
inclusion_rules:
• The task requires communicating in more than one language
• The task involves translating or localising content
• The task requires interpreting spoken or written language
• The task involves working across different cultural or linguistic contexts
• The task requires adapting messaging for multilingual audiences
exclusion_rules:
• The task is performed entirely in a single language
• The user uses automated translation without human adaptation
• The task requires no cultural or linguistic sensitivity
• The user is simply copying text without language skills
insufficient_context_rule: Return insufficient_context=true when the task is single-language, or uses machine translation without human adaptation.

confusions.boundary_rule: Multi-lingualism is language ability. Marketing is messaging strategy.
confusions.example_task: Translate marketing copy so it resonates in Malay and Mandarin.

confusions.boundary_rule: Multi-lingualism enables service in multiple languages, but service is about help.
confusions.example_task: Help a Mandarin-speaking customer in her native language.
confusions.expected_labels: Multi-lingualism; Service orientation and customer service

confusions.boundary_rule: Multi-lingualism is about multiple languages. Reading/writing is about literacy in general.
confusions.example_task: Write a bilingual report in English and Malay.

examples.task_text: Translate the patient intake form into Mandarin and Malay for the local community.
Interpret between the Korean supplier and the English-speaking procurement team.
Use Google Translate to convert a memo without checking it.
